projection: none - edges are observed directly between actors
node_selection: top 120 nodes by incident events, counted over 125235 events; 184 nodes were candidates
time_unit: days from the first event in the raw file
repeated_interactions: collapsed to one edge per window
edge_attributes_available: label (TGB link-prediction target) and idx; neither is an edge weight
partition_source: greedy modularity on the full-period aggregate graph (descriptive; not leakage-safe)
cohesion_note: inactive nodes appear isolated, so snapshots are disconnected and algebraic connectivity is 0; cohesion is not used as a prediction target
